detail.title: 触摸屏贴合装置
detail.abstract: The invention relates to a touch screen attaching device, which comprises a base, two telescopic air cylinders, a vacuum suction plate and force arms, wherein the base is provided with an installing surface; a groove is formed in the installing surface; the two telescopic air cylinders are fixedly arranged at the two opposite side edges of the base; the vacuum suction plate is fixedly arranged at the installing surface; through holes are formed in the vacuum suction plate, and sticky sucking discs are embedded on the vacuum suction plate; each force arm is connected with a telescopic shaft of the corresponding telescopic air cylinder, is accommodated in the groove, and is provided with separation lifting pins movably penetrating through the through holes. The touch screen attaching device has the advantages that the sticky sucking discs arranged on the vacuum suction plate are stuck on the touch screen; then, the vacuum suction plate is used for firmly adsorbing the touch screen; further, the touch screen is attached onto the display screen, so that the problems that after the touch screen touches the display screen, bubbles are generated and position offset occurs due to touch screen jumping during vacuum pumping operation are avoided; high touch precision is realized. After the attaching operation is completed, the two telescopic air cylinders are used for driving the force arms to ascend so as to drive the separation lifting pins for separating the touch screen from the vacuum suction plate and the sticky sucking discs.
